heading.en: Abinadi is imprisoned for prophesying the destruction of the people and the death of King Noah—The false priests quote the scriptures and pretend to keep the law of Moses—Abinadi begins to teach them the Ten Commandments. About 148 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua falepuipui Apinati ona o lona vavalo atu o le faafanoga o le nuu ma le oti o le Tupu o Noa—Ua sii mai e faitaulaga pepelo tusitusiga paia ma faafoliga mai o loo latou tausia tulafono a Mose—Ua amata e Apinati ona a'oa'o atu i latou i Tulafono e Sefulu. E tusa o le 148 T.L.M.

verses.en: And it came to pass that after the space of two years that Abinadi came among them in disguise, that they knew him not, and began to prophesy among them, saying: Thus has the Lord commanded me, saying—Abinadi, go and prophesy unto this my people, for they have hardened their hearts against my words; they have repented not of their evil doings; therefore, I will visit them in my anger, yea, in my fierce anger will I visit them in their iniquities and abominations.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua mavae atu le va o tausaga e lua na sau ai Apinati ia te i latou ua faafoliga ese, sa latou lē iloa ai o ia, ma amata ona vavalo atu ia te i latou, e faapea: Ua faapea ona poloaiina o a’u e le Alii, ua fetalai mai— Apinati e, alu atu ia ma vavalo atu ia i latou nei o lo’u nuu, ona ua latou faamaaa o latou loto e tetee mai i a’u upu; ua latou lē salamo ia latou mea leaga ua fai; o lea, o le a Ou asiasi atu ai ia te i latou i lo’u toasa, ioe, i lo’u toasa tele o le a Ou asiasi atu ai ia te i latou i a latou amioletonu ma mea inosia.

verses.en: Yea, wo be unto this generation! And the Lord said unto me: Stretch forth thy hand and prophesy, saying: Thus saith the Lord, it shall come to pass that this generation, because of their iniquities, shall be brought into bondage, and shall be smitten on the cheek; yea, and shall be driven by men, and shall be slain; and the vultures of the air, and the dogs, yea, and the wild beasts, shall devour their flesh.
verses.sm: Ioe, oi talofa i lenei tupulaga! Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia te a’u: Faaloaloa atu lou lima ma vavalo atu, e faapea: Ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii, o le a oo mai lenei tupulaga i le pologa, ona o a latou amioletonu, ma o le a taia i latou i le alafau; ioe, ma o le a tutulia e tagata, ma o le a fasiotia, ma o le a ’aina o latou tino e taie o le ea, ma ’ulī, ioe, ma manu fe’ai.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass that the life of king Noah shall be valued even as a garment in a hot furnace; for he shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai, o le ola o le tupu o Noa o le a pei le aoga o se ofu i totonu o se ogaumu aasa; ona o le a iloa e ia o A’u o le Alii.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass that I will smite this my people with sore afflictions, yea, with famine and with pestilence; and I will cause that they shall howl all the day long.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai o le a Ou taiaina lo’u nuu lenei i puapuaga tigā, ioe, i le oge ma faama’i; ma o le a Ou faia ia latou tagiauē i le aso atoa.

verses.en: Yea, and I will cause that they shall have burdens lashed upon their backs; and they shall be driven before like a dumb ass.
verses.sm: Ioe, ma o le a Ou faia ia saisai avega i luga o o latou pāpātua; ma o le a tulituli i latou i luma e pei o se asini gūgū.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass that I will send forth hail among them, and it shall smite them; and they shall also be smitten with the east wind; and insects shall pester their land also, and devour their grain.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai o le a Ou auina atu uato’a ia i latou, ma o le a taia ai i latou; ma o le a taia foi i latou i le matagi mai sasa’e; ma o le a faatama’ia foi lo latou laueleele e iniseti, ma ’aina a latou saito.

verses.en: And they shall be smitten with a great pestilence—and all this will I do because of their iniquities and abominations.
verses.sm: Ma o le a taia i latou i se faama’i tele— ma o nei mea uma o le a Ou faia ona o a latou amioletonu ma a latou mea inosia.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass that except they repent I will utterly destroy them from off the face of the earth; yet they shall leave a record behind them, and I will preserve them for other nations which shall possess the land; yea, even this will I do that I may discover the abominations of this people to other nations. And many things did Abinadi prophesy against this people.
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai se’i vagana ua latou salamo, o le a Ou matuā faaumatia lava i latou mai luga o le lalolagi; peitai o le a latou tuua se talafaamaumau pe a mavae atu i latou, ma o le a Ou faasaoina ia talafaamaumau mo isi atunuu o le a mauaina le laueleele; ioe, o le a Ou faia lava lenei mea ina ia mafai ona Ou faaali atu mea inosia a lenei nuu i isi atunuu. Ma e tele mea na vavalo atu ai Apinati e faasaga i lenei nuu.

verses.en: And it came to pass that they were angry with him; and they took him and carried him bound before the king, and said unto the king: Behold, we have brought a man before thee who has prophesied evil concerning thy people, and saith that God will destroy them.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina latou feita ia te ia; ma sa latou noanoatia ma auina atu o ia i luma o le tupu, ma fai atu i le tupu: Faauta, ua matou aumai i ou luma se tagata o lē sa ia valoia mea leaga e uiga i lou nuu, ma fai mai o le a faaumatia i latou e le Atua.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And he also prophesieth evil concerning thy life, and saith that thy life shall be as a garment in a furnace of fire.
verses.sm: Ma sa valoia foi e ia mea leaga e uiga i lou soifua, ma fai mai o le a pei lou soifua o se ofu e i totonu o se ogaumu o le afi.

verses.en: And again, he saith that thou shalt be as a stalk, even as a dry stalk of the field, which is run over by the beasts and trodden under foot.
verses.sm: Ma lea foi, sa fai mai o ia o le a pei oe o se ’ausaito, o se ’ausaito mago lava o le fanua, e taufetuli ai i luga manu vaefa ma soli i lalo o vae.

verses.en: And again, he saith thou shalt be as the blossoms of a thistle, which, when it is fully ripe, if the wind bloweth, it is driven forth upon the face of the land. And he pretendeth the Lord hath spoken it. And he saith all this shall come upon thee except thou repent, and this because of thine iniquities.
verses.sm: Ma lea foi, ua fai mai o ia o le a pei oe o se fuga o se laau tuitui, lea, a oo ina matua lelei, pe a agi le matagi, e lelea atu ai i luga o le laueleele. Ma ua ia faafoliga mai ua fetalai mai ai le Alii. Ma ua fai mai o ia o le a oo mai nei mea uma i ou luga vagana ai ua e salamo, ma o le a oo mai nei mea ona o au amioletonu.

verses.en: And now, O king, what great evil hast thou done, or what great sins have thy people committed, that we should be condemned of God or judged of this man?
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, le tupu e, o se a se leaga tele ua e faia, pe o a foi ni agasala tetele ua faia e lou nuu, o le a ta’usala ai i tatou e le Atua pe ua faamasinoina ai e lenei tagata?

verses.en: And now, O king, behold, we are guiltless, and thou, O king, hast not sinned; therefore, this man has lied concerning you, and he has prophesied in vain.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, le tupu e, faauta, ua matou lē sala, ma o oe, le tupu e, e te lei agasala; o lea, ua pepelo le tagata lenei e uiga ia te oe, ma ua le aogā mea sa ia valoia.

verses.en: And behold, we are strong, we shall not come into bondage, or be taken captive by our enemies; yea, and thou hast prospered in the land, and thou shalt also prosper.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, ua tatou malolosi, o le a lē faapologaina i tatou, pe ave faatagataotaua e o tatou fili; ioe, ma ua e manuia i le laueleele, ma o le a e manuia foi.

verses.en: Behold, here is the man, we deliver him into thy hands; thou mayest do with him as seemeth thee good.
verses.sm: Faauta, o le tagata lenei, matou te tuu atu o ia i ou aao; e mafai ona e faia ia te ia e pei ona lelei ia te oe.

verses.en: And it came to pass that king Noah caused that Abinadi should be cast into prison; and he commanded that the priests should gather themselves together that he might hold a council with them what he should do with him.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faia e le tupu o Noa ia lafo Apinati i le falepuipui; ma sa poloai atu o ia i faitaulaga ia latou faapotopoto faatasi i latou lava ina ia mafai e ia ona faia se fono faatasi ma i latou po o se a se mea e tatau ona ia faia ia te ia.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that they said unto the king: Bring him hither that we may question him; and the king commanded that he should be brought before them.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina latou fai atu i le tupu: Aumai o ia iinei, ina ia mafai ona tatou fesili atu ia te ia; ma sa poloai atu le tupu ia aumai o ia i o latou luma.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And they began to question him, that they might cross him, that thereby they might have wherewith to accuse him; but he answered them boldly, and withstood all their questions, yea, to their astonishment; for he did withstand them in all their questions, and did confound them in all their words.
verses.sm: Ma sa amata ona latou tuufesili atu ia te ia, ina ia mafai ona latou faafesasia’i o ia, ina ia mafai ona latou maua o se mea e tuua’ia ai o ia; peitai sa tali atu o ia ia te i latou ma le mautinoa, ma faamalie a latou fesili uma, ioe, i lo latou ofo tele; ona sa ia mafai ona tali atu ia i latou i a latou fesili uma, ma faafemēmēa’i i latou i a latou upu uma.

verses.en: And it came to pass that one of them said unto him: What meaneth the words which are written, and which have been taught by our fathers, saying:
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina fai mai se tasi o i latou ia te ia: O le a le uiga o upu ua tusia, ma ia sa a’oa’o mai e o tatou tamā, fai mai:

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings; that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good; that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth;
verses.sm: E matuā matagofie lava i luga o mauga vae o ia o lē na te aumai tala e lelei; o lē na te talai atu le filemu; o lē na te aumai tala e lelei o mea lelei; o lē na te talai atu le faaolataga; o lē e fai atu ia Siona, Ua nofotupu lou Atua;

verses.en: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing; for they shall see eye to eye when the Lord shall bring again Zion;
verses.sm: O le a sii a’e le leo o ou leoleo; o le a latou pepese faatasi i lea leo; ona o le a latou faafesagai pe a toe faafoi mai Siona e le Alii;

verses.en: Break forth into joy; sing together ye waste places of Jerusalem; for the Lord hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem;
verses.sm: Alalaga ia i le olioli; pepese faatasi i o outou nofoaga tuufua o Ierusalema; ona ua faamafanafanaina e le Alii lona nuu, ua togiola e ia Ierusalema;

verses.en: The Lord hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations, and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God?
verses.sm: Ua afe e le Alii lona aao paia i mata o atunuu uma, ma o le a vaai tulu’iga uma o le lalolagi i le faaolataga a lo tatou Atua?

verses.en: And now Abinadi said unto them: Are you priests, and pretend to teach this people, and to understand the spirit of prophesying, and yet desire to know of me what these things mean?
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa fai atu Apinati ia te i latou: O outou o faitaulaga, ua manatu e faapea ua outou a’oa’oina lenei nuu, ma malamalama i le agaga o valoaga, ae ua outou fia iloa mai ia te a’u le uiga o nei mea?

verses.en: I say unto you, wo be unto you for perverting the ways of the Lord! For if ye understand these things ye have not taught them; therefore, ye have perverted the ways of the Lord.
verses.sm: Ou te fai atu ia te outou, oi talofa ia te outou i lo outou faapi’opi’o o ala o le Alii! Ona afai ua outou malamalama i nei mea, tou te lei a’oa’oina atu; o lea, ua outou faapi’opi’o ai ala o le Alii.

verses.en: Ye have not applied your hearts to understanding; therefore, ye have not been wise. Therefore, what teach ye this people?
verses.sm: Tou te le’i faaaogaina o outou loto tou te malamalama ai; o lea, sa outou lē popoto. O lea, o ni a ua outou a’oa’o atu i lenei nuu?

verses.en: And they said: We teach the law of Moses.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou fai mai: Ua matou a’oa’o atu le tulafono a Mose.

verses.en: And again he said unto them: If ye teach the law of Moses why do ye not keep it? Why do ye set your hearts upon riches? Why do ye commit whoredoms and spend your strength with harlots, yea, and cause this people to commit sin, that the Lord has cause to send me to prophesy against this people, yea, even a great evil against this people?
verses.sm: Ma sa toe fai atu o ia ia te i latou: Afai ua outou a’oa’o atu le tulafono a Mose aisea ua outou lē tausia ai? Aisea ua pupū ai o outou loto i ’oa? Aisea ua outou faia ai le faitaaga ma faaalu lo outou malosi ma fafine talitane, ioe, ma uunai lenei nuu e fai le agasala, ua faia ai e le Alii e auina mai a’u e vavalo faasaga atu i lenei nuu, ioe, se leaga tele e faasaga i lenei nuu?

verses.en: Know ye not that I speak the truth? Yea, ye know that I speak the truth; and you ought to tremble before God.
verses.sm: Tou te le iloa ea ua ou tautala atu i le upumoni? Ioe, ua outou iloa ua ou tautala atu i le upumoni; ma ua tatau ona outou gatete i luma o le Atua.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass that ye shall be smitten for your iniquities, for ye have said that ye teach the law of Moses. And what know ye concerning the law of Moses? Doth salvation come by the law of Moses? What say ye?
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai o le a taia outou ona o a outou amioletonu, ona ua outou fai mai ua outou a’oa’o atu le tulafono a Mose. Ma pe se a se mea ua outou iloa e uiga i le tulafono a Mose? E ala mai ea le faaolataga i le tulafono a Mose? O ni a fa a outou?

verses.en: And they answered and said that salvation did come by the law of Moses.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou tali mai ma fai mai o le faaolataga e ala mai i le tulafono a Mose.

verses.en: But now Abinadi said unto them: I know if ye keep the commandments of God ye shall be saved; yea, if ye keep the commandments which the Lord delivered unto Moses in the mount of Sinai, saying:
verses.sm: Ae o lenei sa fai atu Apinati ia te i latou: Ua ou iloa afai tou te tausi i poloaiga a le Atua e faaolaina outou; ioe, pe afai tou te tausi i tulafono na tuu mai e le Alii ia Mose i le mauga o Sinai, e faapea:

verses.en: I am the Lord thy God, who hath brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.sm: O A’u o le Alii lou Atua, o lē na aumaia oe mai le nuu o Aikupito, mai le fale o le pologa.

verses.en: Thou shalt have no other God before me.
verses.sm: Aua e te fai mo oe se Atua ese i o’u luma.

verses.en: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing in heaven above, or things which are in the earth beneath.
verses.sm: Aua e te fai mo oe se tupua ua ta, po o se faatusa o se mea o i le lagi i lugā, po o mea o loo i le lalolagi i lalō.

verses.en: Now Abinadi said unto them, Have ye done all this? I say unto you, Nay, ye have not. And have ye taught this people that they should do all these things? I say unto you, Nay, ye have not.
verses.sm: O lenei sa fai atu Apinati ia te i latou, ua outou faia ea nei mea uma? Ou te fai atu ia te outou, E leai, tou te le’i faia. Ma ua outou a’oa’oina ea lenei nuu ia latou faia nei mea uma? Ou te fai atu ia te outou, E leai, tou te le’i aoaoina lava.
